observed_tcn_profile.timing_unit: one outer B8 DataLoader batch including all internal chunks; source timer starts outside and stops after chunk loop

basis.terminal_arm_scope: TCN profile aborted on strict nonfinite/skipped-update evidence; the V2 worker stopped before GRU profile/fit. This is profile execution evidence, not a model-quality grade.

commands.build: WNN_SLICE=wnn-campaign.slice WNN_CPU_QUOTA=100% WNN_THREADS=1 WNN_MEM_MAX=1000000000 WNN_RUNTIME_MAX=120s scripts/limited python3 research/campaign_2026-10-06/bandit_continuation/continuous_execution_E529/vast/build_h217_v3_packet.py

runtime_accounting.formula: 2*900 profile + 2*(7200 fit + 1800 valid export) + 450 setup + 600 package + 750 headroom = 21600.

scientific_successor.delivery: Valid split only at fixed epoch3 in FP32; phases are arm-local; no worker-side score.
scientific_successor.only_scientific_factor: Explicit FP16 GradScaler initial scale4096 in TCN/GRU profile and fit; V2 historical effective default was65536.
scientific_successor.strict_gate_preserved: Requires zero skipped updates, finite loss and gradient evidence, consistent counts and exact effective initial scale; no overflow suppression or profile bypass.
scientific_successor.unchanged: TCN C128/L12 mix1 and GRU256x2 raw-only, seed7, fold0, B8, scratch, train+valid pool, WMSE/chunk, AdamW lr0.001 wd0.01, OneCycle, four epochs, fixed epoch3.

scope: Static H217 V3 packet construction, source/recipe audit, and focused local tests only. No fit, provider create, rental, quota mutation, or A3D reuse.

source_diff_audit.audit_command: diff -qr <V2 project> <V3 project>, excluding local __pycache__ created by static compilation.
expected_changes_only: project/scripts/train_rnn.py (explicit AMP-scale CLI and profile scale receipts)
source_diff_audit.other_sources: All other model/data/objective/split sources are byte-identical to V2.
source_diff_audit.reference: V2 packet project tree copied into isolated V3 project.

validation.bundle: 60 deterministic members; archive SHA matches source manifest; no data arrays, parquet, cache, run or checkpoint files embedded.

pytest.command: WNN_SLICE=wnn-campaign.slice WNN_CPU_QUOTA=100% WNN_THREADS=1 WNN_MEM_MAX=1000000000 WNN_RUNTIME_MAX=180s scripts/limited python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_h217_v3_packet.py

validation.ruff_packet_sources: ruff format --check and ruff check passed for worker.py, amp.py, builder, and focused tests.
validation.syntax: bash -n run.sh passed; py_compile passed for trainer, AMP helper, worker and builder.
validation.trainer_lint: ruff check --select F passed on V3 trainer. Full Ruff reports the same eight findings on the V2 trainer baseline and V3 copy (I001, SIM102, B023×2, B020×2, B007×2); no broad cleanup was included.
